clear_second_pass_candidates.note: Conservative candidates identified from actual title/abstract evidence: direct eligible-species plus farm/aquaculture proximity for retain; clear species/context gate failure, wild/release, or background-only rationale for exclude.

policy_sensitive_remaining.note: These buckets are analytical groupings, not final adjudications. Records can contain nuanced evidence and should be batch-adjudicated using the agreed eligibility policy before canonical changes.
